title: Annotated wireframe: checkout on a phone
desc: Three screens of one task, in grey with blue for the primary action. Numbers point at details, the red dot is the tap target, and the notes below say what each detail does.

annotations.title: Quantity stepper
annotations.text: Changes the line and the total at once. Down to 0 removes the item.

annotations.title: Price per line
annotations.text: Shows the price for the quantity chosen, not per unit.

annotations.title: Promo code
annotations.text: Field and button on one row. Wrong code shows a rose message below.

annotations.title: Primary action
annotations.text: One per screen, at the bottom, with the total in the label.

annotations.title: Address
annotations.text: Saved address first; Change opens a list in a bottom sheet.

annotations.title: Delivery time
annotations.text: One choice at a time. Schedule opens a date picker.

annotations.title: Payment
annotations.text: Selected method has a blue border. Cash hides the card fields.

annotations.title: Place order
annotations.text: Disabled until address and payment are set.

blocks.detail: Pad Thai House is preparing it

annotations.title: Success mark
annotations.text: Green check; no auto-redirect, so the person can read it.

annotations.title: Live ETA
annotations.text: Map and time range update as the courier moves.

annotations.title: Courier
annotations.text: Name, vehicle and arrival time. Tap opens the courier screen.

annotations.title: Next step
annotations.text: Track order is the main action, Done the quiet exit.
